'''Memory augmentors''' were devices that could be surgically installed into a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient's]] [[Brain/Legends|brain]] in order to augment their memory. The [[Lyunesi]] [[Oph Nar Dinnid]] had memory augmentors installed with encrypted information.
